content:
Sam K: Hey folks, quick onboarding question: I started this past Wednesday (4/14). There's a company holiday coming up on 4/21 384 Do new hires get holiday pay if they started this week? Also my corporate card hasn't arrived yet 4b3 I paid for a temporary storage fee during my move 4e6 622 Can I get reimbursed before my first paycheck?
People Ops: Welcome Sam! :tada: Holiday pay is usually granted if your hire is processed in payroll before the holiday date. We'll check the payroll cutoff and confirm. For the storage fee: two options 539 1) Request a virtual Ramp card (can be issued same day once approved) 2) Submit an expense in Concur and request an off-cycle reimbursement via ops@redwood.com.
Taylor P: Payroll note: cutoff is the payroll run's submission deadline (typically the Friday prior). If your paperwork posted after that, holiday pay falls to the next cycle. PTO accrual starts immediately but you will see a prorated balance on your first paystub. DM me your employee email if you want me to verify with payroll.
Sam K: Thanks! If I go Concur path, what's the fastest way to flag it urgent? I want the reimbursement this week if possible.
Ruchi M: File the expense in Concur, tag it "onboarding-relocation", attach receipts, then email ops@redwood.com with the Concur link and cc your manager. Mark subject "Off-cycle reimbursement request - new hire". We can push an off-cycle payment; typical turnaround after approvals is ~2-4 business days. If you need cash same day, request the virtual Ramp card and we'll expedite the approval.
Finance Bot: Reminder: off-cycle transactions require manager + ops approval. Processing ETA depends on bank cutoffs.
Sam K: Great, submitting Concur now and emailing ops. Also flagged my W-4 as completed during onboarding. Appreciate the speedy responses! :pray:
People Ops: Checklist: 1) Confirm W-4 + direct deposit are set 2) Enroll in benefits within 30 days via the benefits portal link from your onboarding email 3) If card delayed, request virtual Ramp card or file Concur + ops email for off-cycle. We'll update this thread once payroll confirms the exact cutoff for the upcoming holiday.
Sam K: Awesome, thanks everyone 44d
